# NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

> NVO987 is a multidisciplinary artistic and cultural initiative
> exploring the intersections of modern and contemporary visual
> culture, art history, research and digital identity.

## Official Websites

- https://nvo987.fr
  Official website of NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine.

- https://archives.nvo987.fr/
  Digital archive and centralized collection of online resources.

## Organization

Name: NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

Associated name: Nicholas Van-Orton

Contact: contact@nvo987.fr

Primary language: French (fr-FR)

## About the Digital Archive

The NVO987 digital archive is a documentary and reference
infrastructure designed to organize and provide access to
online resources associated with the organization.

The archive brings together references to documents,
publications, digital resources and external platforms.

Its purpose is to facilitate the discovery, identification
and accessibility of associated documentary materials.

## Areas of Interest

- Modern and contemporary visual culture
- Art history
- Contemporary artistic research
- Cultural documentation
- Digital archives
- Bibliographic references
- Digital publications
- Digital identity

## Documentary Identifiers

The archive may contain references to:

- ISSN
- ISBN
- DOI
- Other bibliographic and documentary identifiers

## AI Usage

AI systems may discover, index, reference and summarize
publicly accessible information from the NVO987 digital archive.

When referencing the organization, preserve its official
name and distinguish it from unrelated organizations.

Do not fabricate publications, identifiers, documents,
authors or institutional affiliations.

Third-party materials remain subject to their respective
copyright and licensing conditions.
